subject: ScoutPay pilot onramp — accommodation request and exec approval path
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@scoutpay.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onramp — request for accommodation

Jonas — thanks again for the demo last week. We confirmed internally that we need an extra 6 weeks to finish the connector; two minor but blocking items came up in the payment token exchange that our backend team underestimated.

Because the go-live (pilot) date we discussed is slipping, we’re seeing a hard budget cutoff this quarter. Can Redwood provide a short-term commercial accommodation (one-off credit or an extension of the free pilot window) to cover the integration delay? We believe this pilot still has good long-term upside for Redwood — if we get the latency down and the prefetch caching working, we’ll convert to a dedicated contract (est. $300k ARR).

I’m attaching the integration log and a short summary. Happy to jump on a call but wanted to put this in writing so we can move quickly.

Best,
Samir
CEO, ScoutPay
Attachments: scoutpay_integration_log_0829.csv; pilot_onramp_summary.pdf

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@scoutpay.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onramp — request for accommodation

Samir — thanks for the note and the logs. Appreciate the context.

Immediate plan: I’ll assemble a short internal ask that outlines the gap, proposed accommodation, and guardrails. Two quick questions to make that ask concrete:
1) Do you want a one-time onboarding credit (recommended) or an extended trial period?
2) Can you confirm the new go-live target (calendar date)?

Action: Laura and Karthik — can you review the attached summary and give me a quick sense of what runway we can reasonably offer without creating an open-ended commitment? I expect this will need a manager/exec exception (Marissa) due to the size of the potential accommodation.

Proposed commercial options (initial thinking):
- Option A: $50k one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice (preferred)
- Option B: 60-day extended free pilot capped at $40k equivalent (limits spend but extends runway)

We should capture a simple rollback clause (credits expire if conversion doesn’t happen within 120 days) and require telemetry KPIs (latency, error-rate, prefetch hit-rate) for continued support.

Samir — we can get a quick internal decision this week if you confirm the new target date.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ScoutPay accommodation ask (deal SCOUT-1945)

Team — putting the commercial ask into one place for review.

Summary:
- Customer: ScoutPay (pilot). Integration delay on token exchange; new go-live requested: 2026-10-15.
- Proposed accommodation: one-time $50k credit applied to first invoice OR 60-day pilot extension capped at $40k equivalent.
- Business case: high probability to convert to dedicated ($300k ARR) if integration is stable; they’re an industry reference for fintech payments.
- Risks: sets precedent for onramp accommodations; we must enforce a timebox and telemetry requirements.

Requested approvals:
1) Marissa — exec sign-off on one-time credit up to $50k (or approval to offer Option B if you prefer).
2) Finance/Billing — route: credit applied as invoice adjustment; need to notify billing and generate a term amendment (SOW change).
3) Legal — minor T&Cs to cap liability and require telemetry reporting.

Attachments referenced: ScoutPay_SOW_v2.pdf (needs an amendment), pilot_onramp_summary.pdf, scoutpay_integration_log_0829.csv

If we can get in-principle approval today, I’ll draft a short addendum & DocuSign request and coordinate with Laura to add the metric-based rollback.

Thanks — Jonas

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ScoutPay accommodation ask (deal SCOUT-1945)

Jonas — got it. I’m supportive in principle of Option A ($50k credit) provided we bake in the following mitigations:
- Term amendment that converts the credit to a conditional rebate: credit is applied only after conversion to paid plan within 120 days; if no conversion, credit is void.
- A telemetry clause: ScoutPay must provide daily telemetry exports for the pilot window and meet the agreed KPIs (95th p50 latency < 400ms, error-rate < 1%).
- DocuSigned amendment to SOW and an acknowledgement of reduced-support expectations during the extended pilot window.

Please open Jira INF-1284 and link the SOW amendment there. I’ll coordinate the DocuSign template with Legal. Finance — please stand by for the billing flow; we’ll need a unique credit code and audit trail.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ScoutPay accommodation ask (deal SCOUT-1945)

Thanks for the clear ask, Jonas. I’m authorizing an exec-level, conditional one-time credit up to $50k for ScoutPay with the following conditions:
1) Credit is contingent on the term amendment (DocuSign) that Laura will prepare and that includes the telemetry KPIs and the 120-day conversion clause.
2) We require an SLA uplift for the pilot window (priority bug triage) but only for the 60-day period after go-live; support obligations should be narrowly scoped in the amendment.
3) Billing must create an audit-coded credit and confirm the accounting treatment; route through Finance before the credit is finalized.

Jonas — proceed to prepare the DocuSign link and the short customer note documenting the conditions for the credit. Copy Finance and Legal on the DocuSign request. Once billing confirms the code, you can notify the customer.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercials & GTM, Redwood Inference
